boundary.argv: typed literal argv only; shell=false; shell syntax rejected
boundary.environment: explicit non-secret allowlist only; secret-like names rejected
boundary.input: bounded UTF-8 stdin; no arbitrary shell string
boundary.output: selector-drained bounded stdout/stderr with replacement decoding
boundary.timeout: process-group TERM then KILL with observed timed_out flag

claim_ceiling: Provider-neutral process boundary evidence only; no executor live completion or external effect guarantee is inferred.
